t.zh: 卡罗尔的原题：「婴儿都不讲道理」「驯得了鳄鱼的都受人尊重」「不讲道理的都不受人尊重」。证明「婴儿都驯不了鳄鱼」。
t.en: Carroll’s own puzzle: “babies are illogical”, “whoever can tame a crocodile is respected”, “illogical persons are not respected”. Prove “babies cannot tame crocodiles”.

hint.zh: 任取一个 a，假设它是婴儿；要证「¬a驯得了鳄鱼」，就再假设它驯得了，推出矛盾。
hint.en: Take any a and assume it is a baby; to prove “¬a can tame a crocodile”, assume it can, and reach a contradiction.

hint.zh: 婴儿 → 不讲道理 → 不受尊重；驯得了鳄鱼 → 受尊重：撞上了。
hint.en: Baby → illogical → not respected; tames crocodiles → respected: they clash.
